title: Fixed A Frame Trunnion and Ankle Holder Table
description: One newly authored whole static A-frame inversion-table exterior in a fixed empty upright-rest presentation. Two full high A side frames with spread ties and front/rear crossmembers stand on four finite pads. A complete transverse trunnion shaft joins the high sleeves and one continuous long chamfered upholstered board with its full rear spine. A separate full lower extension leads to an actual foot-rest plate and a central bracket carrying two complete opposed ankle-roller rows, each with its own transverse axle and separate thick pads. Two entire curved side handrails root into the high sleeves and front frame legs. This is not a rotated old press bench, its seat/back replacement, low slant board or an oval mirror stand with a different face; all geometry is newly authored. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes, no person. Static illustrative exterior only: no exercise guidance, inversion movement, therapy, medical benefit, suitability, body dimensions, actual restraint, locking, adjustment, stability, load capacity, manufacture or safety is modeled or verified.
